messages:
Ana Romero: Quick kickoff 11 we have permission from Nimbus Labs to publish a customer story. Highlights: 3.5x inference throughput improvement and 22% cost reduction after moving to Redwood Dedicated. Need interviews, legal sign-off, design, and lead routing.

Jasper Li: Nice. Who's our contact and what quote do they want to give?

Ana Romero: Omar Haddad, Head of ML. He agreed to a 2-3 sentence on-record quote and a 20-25min tech interview. Also open to joining a webinar if timeline works.

Kaitlyn Shaw: I can run the interview and capture a short video clip. Wed/Fri afternoons are best for me.

Noah Green: I'll assemble the perf charts and a small appendix with request volume and batch sizes. ETA Tue morning.

Ana Romero: Key callouts for copy: 3.5x throughput, 22% cost reduction, shifted from spot instances + manual autoscale to Dedicated pools with autoscaling and KV cache. Avoid naming exact instance types or partner vendors.

Jasper Li: Drafting hero copy and social variants. Want a dev-focused headline and an exec-friendly one. Also prepping two webinar CTAs.

Kaitlyn Shaw: Suggested interview questions: 1) baseline infra pain 2) migration timeline and risks 3) SLO improvements 4) any unexpected ops wins 5) one-liner for header.

Ana Romero: @ops-bot please add campaign tag when we publish: campaign=nimbus-launch23. Also route inbound leads to NA SDR for trial inquiries.

ops-bot: Will do. Please confirm lead routing: trials -> trials@redwood.ai, enterprise -> enterprise-sales@redwood.ai, region=na.

Ana Romero: Yes — trials and enterprise as above. Also add form checkbox: "Interested in Dedicated capacity" and dropdown: "Workload type (chat, embeddings, rerank, custom)".

Noah Green: Uploaded graphs to the case drive folder with alt text. Included small table: 
```
Metric | Before | After
Throughput (req/s) | 120 | 420
Avg latency | 150ms | 48ms
Infrastructure cost | baseline | -22% (autoscale + cache)
```

Jasper Li: Draft quote submitted to Omar: "Redwood helped us scale inference reliably while lowering our per-unit cost, freeing up our team to focus on model improvements."

Omar Haddad (Nimbus Labs): On record: "Redwood removed a lot of the firefighting around inference infra and let us focus on model quality." Fine with header and a slightly longer quote for the case body.

Kaitlyn Shaw: Scheduling note 1 Zoom invite set for Fri 11:00 AM PST. Will record and share transcript.

Ana Romero: Legal check please. Quote references "removed firefighting" which is non-comparative but includes operational claims. Sending screenshots of perf graphs. @legal-bot any red flags?

legal-bot: Hi team 6 please redact any internal IDs or customer-only URLs from screenshots. Avoid absolute comparative claims like "better than X". The quote is fine but submit final assets for review. Typical turnaround 24-72 hours.

Jasper Li: Noted. Will send redacted graphs and final quote. Also requesting permission to use Omar's headshot and Nimbus logo (they provided logo with brand guidelines).

legal-bot: For logo use: please confirm Nimbus gave explicit permission and follow their guidelines. Send the logo file and the signed release (can be an email thread).

Ana Romero: Got logo release in Omar's email thread. Uploading to Drive.

Noah Green: I trimmed the screenshots to remove config lines and customer IDs, and added a short caption explaining the test conditions.

Jasper Li: Two hero drafts for A/B: 
A) "Nimbus Labs scaled inference 3.5x with Redwood Dedicated."
B) "Predictable throughput and lower costs: how Nimbus Labs sped up ML inference."

Kaitlyn Shaw: I like B for the marketing page, A for developer channels.

tracking-bot: Adding UTM params to campaign assets: utm_source=case-study, utm_campaign=nimbus-launch23, utm_medium=social.

ops-bot: Campaign record created: campaign=nimbus-launch23, publish_window=2024-11-18_to_2024-11-25, assets=case_study, webinar, blog.

Jasper Li: Submitted copy + images to legal for review. Also flagged a micro-site design for the case study team.

legal-bot: Received final quote and redacted images. Clearance granted. Approval ref LEG-2024-389. Please ensure Nimbus logo usage follows attached guidelines.

Ana Romero: Great. Proposed timeline: 
- Tue 2024-11-12: final assets in Drive
- Thu 2024-11-14: legal + design QA complete
- Mon 2024-11-18: publish case study and start social sequence
- Wed 2024-11-20: webinar with Omar (30-40min + 10min live Q&A)

Noah Green: Will provide a short tech appendix for devs to link from the case page. It will include batch sizes, seq lengths, and KV cache hit rate (no PII).

Jasper Li: Webinar promo copy drafted and shared. Also proposing a small gated appendix to capture higher-intent leads (email + role).

ops-bot: Routing rules confirmed for gated appendix: gated leads -> enterprise-sales@redwood.ai, tag: source=case-nimbus, intent=gated_appendix.

Kaitlyn Shaw: Omar confirmed he's happy to be the webinar guest and to answer technical Qs. Recording permissions OK.

Ana Romero: Final ask: can we get a 1-sentence executive quote and a 2-3 sentence technical quote? Omar already provided on-record lines; I'll paste final approved versions into the doc and close the loop.

Omar Haddad (Nimbus Labs): Executive: "Redwood let us scale inference reliably and focus on model improvements." Technical: "By moving to Redwood Dedicated with aggressive batching and KV caching, we increased throughput ~3.5x and reduced operational cost by ~22% while keeping tail latency predictable."

Jasper Li: Quotes saved. Legal approval ref noted. I'll prepare final social cadence and schedule posts.

tracking-bot: Webhook for lead routing created: /webhooks/marketing/lead-router.

ops-bot: Publishing hooks and campaign tags applied.

Ana Romero: Live page URL (once up) please paste here so I can close the thread. Planning to publish 2024-11-18.

ops-bot: Live URL: https://redwood.ai/case/nimbus-labs (scheduled for 2024-11-18 09:00 UTC). Closing thread after publish. :sparkles:
